name: aloud-notes-ppt
description: Read-aloud lecture notes from a PowerPoint deck: one spoken paragraph per slide that explains the slide, its findings and every equation, written as plain statements, statements with their consequence and equation readings (no stage directions, no questions). Copies and renders the deck (PowerPoint COM, never Quit), parallel writer brief, two-column Latin Modern XeLaTeX PDF (13 pt body, 1 cm margins, compact two-line bold title, writing gaps under each slide heading and after each block, optional slide range) with checks for paragraph length, glyphs, overfull lines, page count and slides per page. Skills: `aloud-notes-ppt`.
